5.en: The coach assigned each player a practice partner.
5.zh: 教练给每位队员安排了一名练习搭档。

10.en: There was a significant drop in bus delays after the repair.
10.zh: 维修后，公交晚点的情况明显减少。

11.en: A valid passport is essential for international travel.
11.zh: 持有效护照是国际旅行的必备条件。

12.en: A phone is indispensable when you travel alone.
12.zh: 独自旅行时，手机必不可少。

17.en: The school appointed Maya to lead the science club.
17.zh: 学校任命玛雅负责科学俱乐部。

19.en: The hotel can accommodate up to fifty guests.
19.zh: 这家酒店最多能容纳五十位客人。

21.en: The city adopted a new plan to make buses safer.
21.zh: 市政府采纳了一项让公交更安全的新计划。

28.en: The rule seemed arbitrary because nobody explained it.
28.zh: 这条规定显得很武断，因为没人解释原因。

30.en: We need an alternative route because the bridge is closed.
30.zh: 桥封闭了，我们需要换一条路线。

35.en: Prices vary from store to store, so compare before you buy.
35.zh: 各家商店的价格不同，购买前可以比较一下。

37.en: The bus invariably arrives a few minutes early.
37.zh: 这班公交总是早到几分钟。

41.en: You can modify the text before you print the form.
41.zh: 打印表格前，你可以修改文字。

45.en: This material can tolerate high heat.
